title: The Spare Key in the Plant Pot
story: Jonah locked the flat and then saw his keys on the kitchen table, inside. His phone was in there too. He checked the plant pot by the door, where his sister kept a spare key. The pot was empty. A neighbour called Helen waved from the stairs. She was holding the spare key. Helen had watered the plant and taken the key indoors by mistake. She looked sorry and handed it over. Jonah thanked her and opened the door. He put the spare key on a hook inside a cupboard. Then he sent his sister a message about the new place. Helen laughed and said the plant was still thirsty.
